content: contextvars verified by execution on CPython 3.12: a plain threading.Thread does NOT inherit the parent ContextVar value (sees the default); contextvars.copy_context() captured in the parent plus ctx.run(fn) inside the thread DOES propagate it. asyncio.gather children each get an independent copy — sibling .set() never clobbers a sibling, and the parent value is unchanged after the gather returns.
